title: Pros don't trade one prop firm, they build a stack
caption: Why Tradever's CEO trades several firms, and where Tradever fits in. #tradever #propfirm #daytrading #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: Pros don't trade one prop firm. They build a *stack*.
I trade on multiple prop firms and I utilize that in my stack.
You want to be able to have multiple firms that pay out on different days.
What it adds to the marketplace is another firm that you can trust.
